scope: 48 fixed conditions x 200 draws x N4000; no simulator imports
posterior_summary: equal empirical weights of stored P1 selected draws, no resampling or reweighting
time: native float32 legacy / float64 stable; deltas only both finite; state transitions on full denominator
intervals: descriptive equal-tail 95% and 90%; historical G: hull of quantile and mean +/- z SD, alpha E=.01, adjacent=.05/35, delta=.02
MC: paired sample SD/sqrt(4000); sensitivity intervals shifted by +/-2 SE, diagnostic only; no new decision rule
precision: float32 bit equality after casting stable times is a precision-compatible diagnostic, not proof of identical path
